title: Time format
body:
I've noticed quite a few people on various forums who are a little confused over format of time when entering bg/carbs/insulin data into xDrip+.
I suggest it should allow for using a ":" as well as a "." e.g. 9:30.
Also perhaps a prompt about it using a 24 hour clock?

comments.body: And I'd add to not require putting in the ".".  For example, many times I'll just do something like "14" for the time but xdrip+ doesn't like that so you have to do "14.00".  For that matter, I'd be happy with not having to enter any special signs. Just be able to enter "14" or "1430" and know the app is smart enough make it 14:00 or 14:30.
@gitanO0 Your suggestion is better as there isn't a ":" on the keypad! Actually I think your idea has now been implemented?
@DunePlodder My goodness.  You are right.  Here I go suggesting something that already exists and I didn't even try it.  https://i.giphy.com/media/6yRVg0HWzgS88/giphy.webp
